content.short: CVI Finance is a synthetic asset protocol that helps traders hedge against market volatility.
content.description: CVI Finance, launched on the Ethereum blockchain in early 2021 by Dan Galai, delivers a Crypto Volatility Index designed for crypto investors and traders. The platform helps users manage positions and protect against impermanent loss while hedging against broad market volatility. By using synthetic assets, CVI Finance seeks to profit from swings in volatility without forcing traders to take a fixed bullish or bearish stance.
